## Source of detailed evidence

The repository's GitHub Security code-scanning interface remains the source
for individual alerts, their locations, status, and reviewer dispositions.
This public document intentionally excludes per-alert file paths and messages.

**Publication policy:** aggregate counts only; no raw alert-record YAML or
detailed source scanning results are committed by the dashboard workflow.
The original historical Git commits remain subject to an independent
repository-owner exposure and retention review.
